== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 02:46, 13 November 2026 (UTC)

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from [https://web.archive.org/web/20031209102036/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/MitchBio.htm Meet Mitch Velasco] (already cited): how he started, his Florida travels, his first win over Rusty Zion in Orlando, his rankings, his North Florida tournament work and his plans as Tournaments Advocate. Added the MegaCon Open Qualifier of 1 March 2003 from [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month] (6 February 2003), which says three Shadow Squadron members, Howard Busch, Mitch Velasco and Chris Coffee, "bring this event to you".
